apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.17 — Interruption recovery: when another app (YouTube) takes the audio, lessons now stop cleanly and stay stopped instead of highlighting in silence, and the sound engines restart themselves afterwards — so your next Play sounds without restarting the app. Songs keep their pause-and-resume.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
